name: EPIC 205972576

text.card: A red giant 2,619 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.85 solar masses and 9.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,782 K at its surface.
